title.zh-CN: Quacks：抽到安全筹码，为什么下一抽反而更危险？
title.en: Quacks: Why Can a Safe Chip Make the Next Draw More Dangerous?

summary.zh-CN: 逐枚核算剩余袋子、爆锅后的取舍，以及蓝筹与黄筹改变的不同环节，区分随机结果、选择机会和已保留的进展。
summary.en: Count the remaining bag and separate explosion losses, blue-chip choices, and yellow-chip returns to see how chance, decisions, and retained progress interact.
